current_update_strengths.production_basis: Best validation shrinkage baseline k, reused as a stated current-update approximation

negative_controls.fixed_persistence_note: Shuffling training labels cannot erase a fixed prior-PV rule; outcome-pairing and noise controls test that rule.

protocol.benchmark_policy: Current FVM/quotation are output-only benchmarks and never model inputs or targets.
protocol.control_gate: Real validation MAE must beat median noise-feature and shuffled-validation-outcome MAE by 5%, and Spearman exceed their 95th percentile. Shuffled training targets must also degrade learned models; fixed persistence uses validation-outcome shuffle because its PV rule is not learned from labels.
protocol.current_update: Beta-style PV update with training-residual moment prior strength; FM update uses the validation-selected shrinkage pseudo-appearance strength. No historical within-season validation is claimed.
protocol.elapsed_proxy_basis: Maximum current PV in frozen source, NOT verified completed fixtures or team-specific exposure
protocol.historical_predictors: Certified prior-season event totals only; event rates divide by max(PV,1). No MV/FM, role, club, market or snapshot inputs.
protocol.holdout_policy: Freeze selection artifact first; refit fixed winner on train+validation, evaluate holdout once. Afterwards fit fixed winner on all completed samples for the current forecast.
protocol.ridge_justification: One fixed regularized linear alternative can learn different contributions of the certified event rates without importing forbidden prior vote averages.
protocol.selection: Lowest validation total-proxy MAE among baselines; Ridge only if >=2% better MAE and Spearman no more than 0.01 worse. No holdout-based changes.
protocol.target: PV times source FM: approximate rated-appearance fantasy contribution, not exact custom-league points
protocol.uncertainty: Validation 80th percentile absolute total-proxy error, scaled by remaining opportunities; cold-start x1.5 or low-prior-PV x1.25 heuristic inflation. Report holdout coverage; current intervals are not calibrated probabilities.

selection_basis: VALIDATION_ONLY; holdout outcomes not parsed in this phase
selection_rule: Lowest validation total-proxy MAE among baselines; Ridge only if >=2% better MAE and Spearman no more than 0.01 worse. No holdout-based changes.
